Mozilla Readability 0.6.0 (https://github.com/mozilla/readability)

Slack Clipper 1.0.1 ships a modified Readability.js as Readability.cjs.
Two changes: retry from cloned DOM nodes; move an already parsed noscript
image subtree instead of assigning serialized HTML. Text is never reparsed.
The rest of the upstream parser, including article scoring, is unchanged.
See upstream.patch in the source package for the complete diff.

Upstream npm package: @mozilla/readability@0.6.0
Upstream git commit: 4d5dd0bbe0bfbc44e219dc86865131e79639e30b
Original Readability.js SHA-256: 34dcab3d0832d0019f02990eed6b6124e029e8c32b9f0c6f2550544ff8dff174
